card.name: Frequency words in dosing and side effects
card.fires_on: Words about how often something happens or is given, such as every, often, frequent, incidence, consistently, and the t.i.d. abbreviation, in dosing and adverse-reaction sentences.

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: The word every or a count word right after a dose amount, leading into an interval.
